crossRefs.note: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

translations.web: So you also have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans likewise.
translations.bsb: In the same way, some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translations.kjv: So hast thou also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, which thing I hate.
translations.asv: So hast thou also some that hold the teaching of the Nicolaitans in like manner.
